newsitem.title: USA: Alabama House committee okays $80 million park GOs.
newsitem.headline: Alabama House committee okays $80 million park GOs.

text.p: Alabama's House Ways and Means Committee approved an $80 million general obligation bond issue for state parks Tuesday, a legislative aide said.
The proposal now goes to the full house. The bill was sponsored by Rep. Steve McMillan, R-Bay Minette, and has support from Gov. Fob James.
If approved in the legislature, the 20-year bond issue would still have to be approved by voters. Debt service would be paid with State Park Fund revenues.
